info.name: Gloaro Mart — Mobile APIs
info.description: Customer/mobile flows. Run "Auth → login" first: it saves {{token}}, which every other request sends as a Bearer token. Set baseUrl (and webhookSecret for the wallet webhook) in the collection variables.

request.description: Without RESEND_API_KEY the code is printed in the server console.

item.name: POST /api/auth/otp/verify — paste code into {{otp}} first; saves token
POST /api/auth/reset-password — paste the emailed code into {{resetToken}}
PATCH /api/auth/change-password — keeps this device signed in
DELETE /api/auth/me — anonymizes the account — run last
PUT /api/products/{{productId}}/review — needs a delivered order containing the product

item.description: Run top-up → webhook → status → balance in order. The balance only changes after the signed webhook.

item.name: POST /api/wallet/topup — step 1 — opens a pending top-up, saves topupId

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.topupId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('topupId', j.topupId); pm.collectionVariables.set('topupAmount', j.amountCents); }

item.name: POST /api/payments/webhook/manual — step 2 — simulate the gateway (needs webhookSecret)

request.description: Signed in a pre-request script with HMAC-SHA256 over the exact body. Set collection variable webhookSecret to the server PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Send twice to confirm a replay does not credit again.
